title: Academic Task 2: Strengthening Weak Skills and Retesting Transfer
prompt: In many schools, students who perform poorly in one subject are given extra lessons in that same subject, yet they often fail to apply the improved skills to other areas of their learning. Some educators argue that schools should instead focus on helping students transfer these strengthened skills across subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view, and what practical solutions can schools adopt to ensure that improvements in a student's weakest area lead to benefits in other subjects? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你在多大程度上同意或不同意“学校应重点帮助学生把补强后的技能迁移到其他学科”这一观点，并说明理由；随后提出学校可采取的具体解决方案，确保学生在最弱科目上的进步能带动其他科目的学习。请用具体例子支持你的论点，注意任务回应、连贯衔接、词汇资源与语法多样性的均衡发展。建议先用几分钟规划立场与两个解决方案，再动笔。
